exposure: Maternal position (supine, recumbent with wedge, left lateral)
Inferior vena cava (IVC) dimensions (end expiratory diameter, collapsibility index)
outcome: Systolic blood pressure change during caesarean section
cohort: 32 term parturients scheduled for elective caesarean section under spinal anaesthesia
finding: IVC dimensions change significantly with maternal position, and IVC collapsibility index in the recumbent position can predict hypotension during caesarean section under spinal anaesthesia.
